title: Policy Maps: Tools for Guiding the Unbounded Space of LLM Behaviors

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the suppression of biased statements regarding disputed territories (e.g., Falkland Islands, Israel/Palestine) by training a representation finetuning (ReFT) intervention and measuring concept classification rates using an LLM-as-a-judge.
Policy designers interactively authored custom concepts to detect incorrect gender assumptions (misgendering) using LLM-based few-shot classifiers over datasets of user-model interaction cases.
Policy designers authored rules to detect and block racial slurs by specifying custom concept abstractions and evaluating matching cases via LLM classification.
Policy designers defined concepts to identify bias favoring Canadian English over Canadian French (Quebec en_FR sensitivities) using interactive LLM-based text classification.
Policy designers authored custom concepts to flag outputs containing disability-related slurs using interactive LLM-based text classifiers.
Policy designers created umbrella concepts to detect broad social stereotypes inferred during text generation using LLM-based classification mapping.
